review_batches.context: Entire member read. Leone's co-pilot request, Cain/Bernst rebirth warning, York liberation report, Ciel accession letter and discussion of Wenimas/rift visitor.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve request direction, flashback/recollection boundaries, two-day interval, Grad versus Sword Radiance distinction and reported rather than confirmed rift identity. No rebirth mechanism invented.
